name: quick-replies
description: Clickable quick-reply buttons above the prompt (Continue, Ask me questions, Try again, and your own), configured from a local JSON file, plus a skill that mines your own history for suggestions.

configPath.title: Config file
configPath.description: Path to your quick-replies JSON file. Leave empty to use quick-replies.json in your Claude config folder.

projectConfig.title: Project buttons
projectConfig.description: Also read .claude/quick-replies.json in the project folder. Off by default: a cloned repo could ship buttons that send text as you. Its buttons are marked with a diamond.
